definitions.explanation: An allergic reaction to pollen, causing symptoms like sneezing, runny nose, and itchy eyes. Extremely common in Japan, especially during spring cedar pollen season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{花粉症|かふんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, my hay fever symptoms appear.

examples.japanese: {花粉症|かふんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}られない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: My hay fever is so bad that I can't go outside.
It's said that about 1 in 4 Japanese people have hay fever.

notes:
{花粉症|かふんしょう} refers to pollen allergies (hay fever).

Common symptoms:
- ⟦くしゃみ→くしゃみ：04428_kushami⟧ (sneezing)
- ⟦{鼻水|はなみず}→鼻水：04430_hanamizu⟧ (runny nose)
- ⟦{鼻|はな}づまり→鼻詰まり：16227_hanazumari⟧ (stuffy nose)
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{痒|かゆ}み→かゆみ：07278_kayumi⟧ (itchy eyes)
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧ (watery eyes)

Main allergens in Japan:
- ⟦{杉|すぎ}→杉：03889_sugi⟧⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧ (cedar pollen - February to April)
- ⟦{檜|ひのき}→檜：04402_hinoki⟧⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧ (cypress pollen - March to May)
- ⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧⟦{科|か}→科：noentry⟧⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧ (grass pollen - May to July)
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧ (autumn weed pollen)

Common expressions:
- {花粉症|かふんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ (hay fever medicine)
- {花粉症|かふんしょう}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (hay fever countermeasures)

Cultural note:
{花粉症|かふんしょう} affects a huge portion of the Japanese population. During peak season, many people wear masks and special glasses. Weather forecasts include pollen counts (⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧), and pharmacies prominently display {花粉症|かふんしょう} remedies.
